description: This file defines data models, query parameters, and a data fetcher for regional data from the FRED API, including classes for query parameters, data representation, and asynchronous data fetching logic.

classes.name: FredRegionalQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching regional data from FRED, including filtering options like region type, frequency, and transformation.

classes.name: FredRegionalData
classes.description: Represents a single regional data point with attributes such as region name, code, value, and series ID.

classes.name: FredRegionalDataFetcher
classes.description: Asynchronous fetcher class that retrieves and processes regional data from the FRED API based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a FredRegionalQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs the API request URL based on query parameters and fetches raw data from the FRED API.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Processes raw API response data, validates, and converts it into a list of FredRegionalData instances, including handling metadata.
